vocabulary.meaning: the personal name given to someone at birth or naming
examples: Given name is an important idea when discussing the stories behind our names.
Learning about given name can help us understand this issue more clearly.

vocabulary.meaning: the family name shared by members of a family
examples: People often have different views about surname when discussing the stories behind our names.
Understanding surname can make a conversation about this topic more precise.

vocabulary.meaning: a person or thing that has the same name as another
examples: The topic of the stories behind our names raises useful questions about namesake.
We can discuss how namesake affects people, communities, or the environment.

vocabulary.meaning: the qualities and experiences that make a person who they are
examples: Identity can play an important role in debates about the stories behind our names.
Different countries may deal with identity in different ways.

vocabulary.meaning: the traditions, culture, and history passed down through generations
examples: A discussion about the stories behind our names can include the effects of heritage.
Knowing the meaning of heritage makes it easier to express an opinion on this issue.

vocabulary.meaning: a customary way in which a culture or family chooses names
examples: Naming tradition is useful vocabulary for talking about the stories behind our names.
We can use the idea of naming tradition to compare different experiences and viewpoints.
